name: demo_tx_range
description: Log in with the given username and password, open Find Transactions for the given account, search for transactions between the given start date and end date, and read how many transactions matched into an output named match_count

approved_plan.goal: Log in with the given username and password, open Find Transactions for the given account, search for transactions between the given start date and end date, and read how many transactions matched into an output named match_count

steps.intent: Log in with the supplied username and password and reach the Accounts Overview page
steps.action: Replay reusable fragment parabank_login@1.0.0 with the supplied username and password

steps.intent: Navigate to Find Transactions for the given account
steps.action: Locate and click the 'Find Transactions' link in the navigation menu, then select or confirm the account identified by account_id

steps.intent: Enter the date range and search for transactions
steps.action: Fill in the start date field with start_date and the end date field with end_date, then submit the search

steps.intent: Read the number of matched transactions into match_count
steps.action: Count the transaction results returned on the page and record that count as match_count

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The username used to log in to ParaBank

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: The password used to log in to ParaBank

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: The account number for which to find transactions

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: The start date of the transaction search range (MM-DD-YYYY)

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: The end date of the transaction search range (MM-DD-YYYY)

approved_plan.success_signal: The Find Transactions results page is displayed showing a transaction results table or a 'No transactions found' message, confirming the search completed successfully
